dogecoin.text: @bitpanda I've just received the card. It's nice, thank you, though a more sturdy one would be welcome. I plan to use $doge as my payment asset; I'm missing $nano or $zil for fallback. Swap fees are also high compared to other exchanges. It will be an interesting experiment in any case.

@bitpanda Today, I managed to carry out my first payment with Bitpanda card. I paid for a car check. Although the card had to be activated first, the transaction went smooth and it was immediately visible in the account. I used $ADA to pay since $DOGE has been put on hodl. To be repeated!
